text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A few days after the Arima Kinen…

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text: Congratulations on winning the Best Senior award!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text: You've had a fantastic senior year with your victories! We'd love to hear a few words from you…

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text: But before that, we have a surprise guest!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On the announcer's cue, a figure gallantly enters the stage. It's none other than…

text_block_list.name: Fuji's Mother
text_block_list.text: Hello, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Hey, isn't that a super famous actor?! Oh, I remember now! She's Fuji Kiseki's mother!

text_block_list.name: Fuji's Mother
text_block_list.text: I thought it would be best to watch my daughter's big moment unfold backstage, but…

text_block_list.name: Fuji's Mother
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! I just couldn't resist! Seeing you surprised never gets old!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: But of course I'm surprised! You usually never come onstage for things like this.

text_block_list.name: Fuji's Mother
text_block_list.text: Don't worry, I'm not here to steal your spotlight. There's just something I wanted to tell you. I'll keep it short!

text_block_list.name: Fuji's Mother
text_block_list.text: To tell you the truth, I was worried about you, having me as a mother. You wanted to be me so much when you were young.

text_block_list.name: Fuji's Mother
text_block_list.text: But you aren't me. Even if you tried to walk the same path as me, it would have been impossible for you to obtain what you desired.

text_block_list.name: Fuji's Mother
text_block_list.text: But despite my worries, you were able to choose your own path and earn irreplaceable triumph and respect for yourself.

text_block_list.name: Fuji's Mother
text_block_list.text: My daughter, the pride you feel now is a treasure beyond measure.

text_block_list.name: Fuji's Mother
text_block_list.text: You must treasure it and never lose it. Congratulations again, my love.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I will! And thank you, Mother!

text_block_list.name: Fuji's Mother
text_block_list.text: I must thank your trainer too! Thank you so much for supporting my daughter. I'm counting on you to keep watching over her.

text_block_list.name: Fuji's Mother
text_block_list.text: Thank you all for listening! And now, I must pass the baton back to Fuji!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Thank you, everyone, for choosing me for this award and the wonderful surprise!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: And thank you so much for coming here despite your busy schedule, Mother.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Like my mother said, my self-confidence has become strong and pliant over these past three years.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I was only capable of gaining this confidence thanks to the support of my loved ones.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: And so, as a small gesture of thanks…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She makes a flourish and two flower bouquets appear in her arms.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I'd like to gift these blue stars to you. And for you, Mother, please take these red geraniums. Thank you so much, both you!

text_block_list.name: Fuji's Mother
text_block_list.text: Oh my! Does this mean you knew I was coming from the beginning?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Not at all! I just thought it would be nice if I could give them to you, so I prepared this bouquet just in case.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: It isn't too much, is it? Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Fuji's Mother
text_block_list.text: Oh, to think you'd be the one surprising me. Since when did you become so wily and wonderful, dear?

text_block_list.name: Fuji's Mother
text_block_list.text: Geraniums, hm? They're lovely. Thank you for the gift, Fuji.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I should be thanking you. Thank you both for being there for me. I hope you'll continue to support me.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: On that note.. once more, thank you for this award!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: But don't go thinking things are over! There are more miracles to be granted than there are stars in the sky!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I hope you all stay tuned for my next one!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fuji Kiseki's award ceremony ends to the warm sound of applause and cheers.
